request.style: English, male solo voice, solemn baritone, organ, harp, flute, strings, somber and reflective mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
After Joshua died and went away
The people asked the Lord what to say
Which tribe should go up first to fight
Against the Canaanites in the light
The Lord said Judah is the one
He gave them power to be done
Judah spoke to Simeon his kin
Let us go and let them win

[Verse]
Judah went up as the Lord had said
He and Simeon marched ahead
They struck down ten thousand men
In the land where the enemies wend
At Bezek they found the ruler there
And fought with violence and care
They defeated Canaanites and Perizzites
And made the battlefields their sites

[Verse]
Adoni-Besek tried to flee
But they pursued him to be free
They captured him and cut off his thumbs
And big toes from his limbs
He said as he looked around
Seventy kings with no sound
Used to pick up scraps under my table
A grim and terrible fable

[Verse]
As I have done so God has repaid me
My justice now comes to be
He brought him to Jerusalem’s gate
Where his life came to a date
There he died in the holy city
His story written in history
A warning of God’s righteous hand
Over wickedness in the land
